verdict.rationale: Calendly explicitly advertises connecting multiple calendars and syncing them to check for conflicts before booking (calendly-docs-15, calendly-docs-42, calendly-docs-49), and this is independently corroborated by long-time users calling multi-calendar conflict checking a 'killer feature' (calendly-comm-6) and describing two-way availability checks (calendly-comm-13). Missing for 10: explicit naming of Google/Outlook/Apple as the three supported providers in one place, and a hands-on report confirming zero double-booking across all three simultaneously (one community note shows failure if a user disables Google Calendar integration, calendly-comm-10, though this is a config issue rather than a conflict-detection failure).
